name: Maxwell Timothy
bio: Maxwell Timothy builds and reviews AI customer support tooling. He's the founder behind Heyy, an AI Employees platform for customer support teams, and writes hands-on reviews of chatbots, AI agents, and CX platforms based on direct usage, vendor documentation, and independent reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Reddit, and Hacker News. Every tool on this site is scored against the same rubric, documented on the methodology page, regardless of whether Maxwell has a product in that category.
credentials: Founder, Heyy (AI Employees for customer support)
